translations.web: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.
translations.bsb: He cast two pillars of bronze, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.
translations.kjv: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass ➔ either of them about.
translations.asv: For he fashioned the two pillars of brass, eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits compassed either of them about.
